zh: 需要压过宿主界面的 z-index 改由令牌表里的一组层级令牌给出（`packages/client/src/theme/tokens.json` 的 `layer`：输入框控件、输入框里的选择器、窗口标题行、浮动卡片、整窗界面五层），`docs/STYLE.md` 里多了一张由同一份数据生成的层级表；构建拒绝样式表里 9 以上的 z-index 字面值与 TS 里内联写出的层级。lint 新增复制代码检查：jscpd 按仓库根目录的 `.jscpd.json` 扫描源码与脚本，`scripts/jscpd-baseline.json` 记着检查立下之前已有的 36 处复制，此外再出现一处即失败，`npx jscpd` 列出全部复制。构建对「没有读者的动效令牌」的检查此前把令牌样式表自身算作读者、从未生效，现在只算其他样式表、模块与其他令牌的值。
en: A z-index that has to clear the host's interface now comes from a group of layer tokens in the token table (the `layer` group of `packages/client/src/theme/tokens.json`: the composer's controls, a picker inside the composer, the window's title row, floating cards, whole-window surfaces), with a layer table generated from the same data in `docs/STYLE.md`; the build refuses a z-index literal above 9 in a stylesheet and a stacking level written inline in TypeScript. Lint gains a copied-code check: jscpd scans the sources and scripts as the repository root's `.jscpd.json` says, `scripts/jscpd-baseline.json` records the 36 copies that predate the check, and any further copy fails; `npx jscpd` lists every copy. The build's check for motion tokens nothing reads counted the token sheet itself as a reader and so never fired; it now counts only the other stylesheets, the modules and other tokens' values.
